notes.title: Update V1.1.2 – New Leader, Endless Levels & More!
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear Captains！[/b][/p][p][/p][p]First of all, thank you. Your reviews, comments, and feedback keep the wheels of the Last Ship turning. Even though we’re a small crew, every bug report, every screenshot, and every suggestion reminds us we’re not rolling alone.[/p][p]With [b]v1.1.2[/b], we’re bringing you a fierce new Leader, more endless battlegrounds to conquer, fresh trinkets and gadgets, refined balance, and key fixes — all shaped by your voices. We hope this update makes every zombie-crushing run smoother, sharper, and even more satisfying.[/p][p][/p][h2]NEW FEATURES AND CONTENT[/h2][list][*][p]Added a new Leader: Shadow Koga, who will show up in Hard and Hell mode difficulties only, and all Endless Mode difficulties.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new endless levels that are unlocked after completing The Fortress.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 4 new trinkets:[/p][list][*][p]Greedy Heart[/p][/*][*][p]Shuriken[/p][/*][*][p]Superchilled Orbs[/p][/*][*][p]Assistant No.8[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added 1 new gadget:[/p][list][*][p]Explosive Package
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]BALANCE[/h2][p]
[b]Trinket[/b][/p][list][*][p]Orb of Cold rarity: Rare -> Common[/p][/*][*][p]Orb of Poison rarity: Rare -> Common[/p][/*][*][p]Sphere of Frost: Epic -> Rare[/p][/*][*][p]Sphere of Toxicity: Epic -> Rare[/p][/*][*][p]Force Field: Epic -> Legendary[/p][/*][*][p]Zombie Chronometer: Common -> Rare[/p][/*][*][p]Zombie Chronometer:[/p][list][*][p]Old: On Kill: 10% (+5% per stack) chance to reduce Gadget CD by 1s.[/p][/*][*][p]New: On Kill: 10% (+1% per stack) chance to reduce Gadget CD by 1s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Zombie Chronometer+:[/p][list][*][p]Old: On Kill: 15% (+7.5% per stack) chance to reduce Gadget CD by 1s.[/p][/*][*][p]New: On Kill: 15% (+1.5% per stack) chance to reduce Gadget CD by 1s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Suspicious Syringe:[/p][list][*][p]Old: On Kill: 20% (+10% per stack) chance to explode for 25% (+15%) max HP[/p][/*][*][p]New: On Kill: 20% chance to explode for 15% (+10%) max HP[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Suspicious Syringe+:[/p][list][*][p]Old: On Kill: 30% (+15% per stack) chance to explode for 25% (+15%) max HP[/p][/*][*][p]New: On Kill: 30% chance to explode for 15% (+15%) max HP[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Gadget[/b]
[/p][list][*][p]Emergency Protocol[/p][list][*][p]Old: Heal Amount: 1000 + 100% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][*][p]New: Heal Amount: 1500 + 50% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Emergency Protocol+[/p][list][*][p]Old: Heal Amount: 1500 + 150% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][*][p]New: Heal Amount: 2000 + 100% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Orbital Laser[/p][list][*][p]Old: Damage: 100 +  200% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][*][p]New: Damage: 200 + 400% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Orbital Laser+[/p][list][*][p]Old: Damage: 150 +  300% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][*][p]New: Damage: 300 + 600% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Overclock[/p][list][*][p]Old: Turret Damage Mult: 200% + 20% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][*][p]New: Turret Damage Mult: 300% + 10% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Overclock+[/p][list][*][p]Old: Turret Damage Mult: 200% + 30% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][*][p]New: Turret Damage Mult: 350% + 15% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Millenium Sword[/p][list][*][p]Old: Damage per Sword: 10 + 1% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][*][p]New: Damage per Sword: 10 + 5% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Millenium Sword+[/p][list][*][p]Old: Damage per Sword: 15 + 1.5% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][*][p]New: Damage per Sword: 15 + 7.5% x (Gadget Power)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]QOL[/h2][list][*][p]Gacha Altars now display their price inside their interaction circle.[/p][/*][*][p]Fireknight’s Boots will now trigger its shield and block lava damage from both the environmental lava and the black lava created by Lava Ooze zombies[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the VFX of the Gadget: Emergency Protocol[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the VFX of the trinket: Force Field[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard players can now use ESC to close the Unlock Road on the Main Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to reduce the crew member status display size in the Settings. This option is enabled by default.[/p][/*][/list][p]

[/p][h2]BUG FIXES[/h2][list][*][p]Fix a bug where Automatons spawned by the Automaton Gadget and their interaction with the trinket “Buddy’s Package” could crash the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a bug where the player’s Armor sometimes worked twice as well in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a bug where the Boss’s HP bar could overlap with the Storm progress bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a bug where shield zombies could not attack when their shield was broken, leading them to forever be stuck trying to give hugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a bug where displaying very large damage numbers would lead to erroneous numbers being displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a bug when dismissing crew members the UI would not immediately reflect the change in crew count[/p][/*][*][p]Improve the Colliders of a few POI locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix a bug where the green aura from Wishlist zombies would sometimes stick around on random zombies.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This update is just one pit stop on a much longer road ahead. notes.title: Captain, We Heard You: Keybinds, Balance Tweaks, and Big Fixes Arrive in v1.0.2!
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear Captains！[/b][/p][p]First of all, thank you. Your support, reviews, feedback, and bug reports have helped steer the Last Ship through uncharted waters. We may be a small crew, but with every message, comment, and screenshot you share, we feel like we’re not sailing alone.[/p][p]With v1.0.2, we’re introducing meaningful quality-of-life improvements, gameplay balance, new features, and crucial bug fixes — all based on your voices. We hope this update makes your zombie-splatting journey smoother, more strategic, and a little more satisfying.[/p][p][/p][h2]NEW FEATURES[/h2][p]● Keybinding options for Keyboard and Mouse in the Settings.[/p][p]● Postgame stats when the battle ends.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p]● Corrected several text displays errors.[/p][p]● Fixed missing text in some languages.[/p][p]● Fixed an issue where sometimes the ESC key won’t close the panel.[/p][p]● Added a backup player save file to help with save recovery if corruption occurs due to software or hardware failure.[/p][p]● Fixed a visual bug with Specky’s Anvil where it can be stuck in the air when attacking aerial enemies.[/p][p]● Fixed an issue where Ship Component challenges’ effects did not apply properly in-game.[/p][p]● Toned down the volume of some sound effects when collecting many loot at once.[/p][p]● Fixed an issue where the Destroyed Ark chest would drop nothing after playing a tutorial level.[/p][p]● Fixed a bug that could cause some zombie leaders to no longer target anything.[/p][p]● Prevent some locations from being placed in the middle of lava when they shouldn’t.[/p][p]● Fixed a bug where the boss trinkets would not apply their effect if the boss is spawned too early.[/p][p]● Fixed a game freeze bug that occurred when both Zombie Automations and Buddy’s Package were equipped.[/p][p] [/p][h2]BALANCE[/h2][p]We’ve received all the feedback and suggestions, and we’ve been listening closely to what players think, feel, and want. Based on this, we’ve made balancing adjustments, especially for the Forest and Lava environments, to provide a smoother experience on Normal difficulty.
[/p][p]● In Normal Difficulty, the Trees in Chapter 2 will be much easier to destroy.[/p][p]● Remove some unbreakable obstacles in some chapters that interrupted the level flow.[/p][p]● Decrease the base damage and jump speed of Zombie Jumper[/p][p]● Decrease the base damage of Saw Cart[/p][p]● Decrease the healing speed of Swamp Ooze[/p][p]● Increased weight of leader zombies, making them harder to blow away[/p][p]● Reduce the damage that lava at the edge of a pool will deal while it is rising, giving players more time to avoid catastrophic damage[/p][p]● Change the timing of meteors to occur slightly before the lava rises, thereby better indicating when it will occur[/p][p]● Increase the loot quality in puzzles that are harder than normal[/p][p]● Increase the clip size and shoot angle of the Turret Water Cannon[/p][p]● Golden Shovel will no longer affect trinkets, gadgets, or paper[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2]QOL AND PERFORMANCE[/h2][p]● Add a UI bar to help indicate the storm progress and clear condition[/p][p]● Add colored rarity frames for items in the Garage.[/p][p]● Add a toggle in the settings for minimap rotation lock[/p][p]● Added an option to view the Unlock Road in the menu[/p][p]● Display more info for crew skills when viewing a crew member in the gallery or garage[/p][p] [/p][p]This is just one stop on a much longer rolling voyage. We’re already working hard on the next chapter — new level, tougher Leader, more surprises — and we’ll continue listening closely as we go.[/p][p]Thank you again for standing by our side on deck. Let’s keep making the Last Ship something truly special — together.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]🌐 Join the community below![/p][p]💬 Discord: [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/vNGssanw"]https://discord.gg/vNGssanw[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]🐦 Twitter: @ZombieRollerz[/p][p]See you on the battlefield — and remember: [b]“Don’t ask what survival is. Just keep firing!”[/b][/p][p]— With love from the Zombie Rollerz Dev Team[/p]

With that, we wanted to take this opportunity to thank you all for playing thus far! ːsteamhappyː[/h3][p][/p][h3]To take the game further and see community sentiment and creativity, we have created this contest to see posts and social activity surrounding the game! [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576506/6fa0ca3a8f45bda15ad4a92fdbc7937a230c5093.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Here are the details surrounding this contest:[/h2][list][*][p][b]From June 27 - July 11, you the community are invited to post or create content regarding your favorite ship builds![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Players and Influencers alike are invited to participate in a ship building contest to showcase their favorite ship builds. This build will showcase their favorite turrets, ship parts, favorite captain and favorite gadgets and starting trinkets that lead into gameplay of the ship build. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Winning Criteria: [/b]The winner will be selected by [b]Wandering Wizard Games[/b] and [b]Zing Games[/b] for a post or video that is [b]thorough[/b] in explanation: A winning argument as to why your ship build is the best/most unique, that is persuasive enough to engage new and current and new players to try the build in-game. Tutorial [url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=181142704"]here[/url].[/h3][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Now here is what you are really here for, the Prizes![/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Grand Prize (1 winner):[/b] [b]512 GB, OLED Steamdeck Console![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576506/8007ddb3c6c80cf0b4859daf60e2bc50d9c0a7c5.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]2nd - 11th place:[/b] [b]$100 Steam Gift card code![/b][/h3][p][/p][h3]We look forward to your submissions! notes.title: Zombie Rollerz: The Last Ship – v1.0.1 Patch Preview & Future Plans
notes.content:
[p][/p][h2][b]Zombie Rollerz: The Last Ship – v1.0.1 Patch Preview & Future Plans[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Dear Captains,[/p][p]We want to express our heartfelt thanks for your support of our game. As a small team of just four people, we know the current version still has areas that need improvement. After receiving your feedback, we immediately began investigating bugs and optimizing the game. We’re committed to doing [b]everything[/b] we can to keep improving through updates.[/p][p][b]Your support and feedback[/b] are what drive us forward, and we will continue working hard to enhance every Captain’s gameplay experience.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b](v1.0.1) Fixes[/b]
The following issues have been resolved and will be included in a patch planned for next week:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where balloons from the Balloon Launcher would sometimes fail to lock onto targets within range.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected several text display errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where notification icons (red dots, upgrade indicators, new items) could incorrectly disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed occasional errors with background music transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rendering issue causing magma projectile trails to display incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing text in some languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare bug where the ship could fall through the ground indefinitely.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed treasure chest icons desyncing with the minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare bug where Ooze Zombies could get stuck lying flat.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized forest stages for higher frame rates on Steam Deck.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Key Bugs and Optimization Issues in Progress[/b]
We are actively addressing the following issues and will do our best to update quickly:[/p][list][*][p]Adding an option to unlock the 60 FPS cap for high refresh rate monitors.[/p][/*][*][p]Investigating a bug where the boss’s HP can drop to or below zero, preventing it from dying.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing a bug where storms may never end in certain conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing a bug causing some turrets to stop targeting enemies even when repaired and loaded with ammo. (Temporary workaround: move the turret in the management page to reset it and restore functionality.)[/p][/*][*][p]Speeding up the animation speed of the Gacha Altar.[/p][/*][*][p]Improving how keyboard and controller input switching works while a controller is connected.[/p][/*][*][p]Adding basic keybinding options through editable configuration files.[/p][/*][*][p]Adding more support for the ESC key to quickly close UI windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing a bug where audio can randomly drop out during intense action.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Future Update Plans[/b]
We are planning the following new features and improvements for future updates:[/p][list][*][p]Continuously optimizing and adjusting the difficulty progression curve across game stages.[/p][/*][*][p]Adding a trail indicator on the minimap to help players navigate more easily.[/p][/*][*][p]Introducing a Hell+ difficulty mode with infinite time.[/p][/*][*][p]Adding secondary challenge missions to give players optional goals during each run.[/p][/*][*][p]Implementing a score exchange shop so accumulated points can be spent on items (details TBD).[/p][/*][*][p]Adding a post-run damage summary screen so players can analyze their weapon and trinket builds with detailed stats.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Long-Term Update Commitment[/b]
Thank you for placing your trust in us and supporting the game during its launch. We are fully committed to providing long-term updates, continuously optimizing the game, and adding new content. Here are a few directions we plan to pursue for future updates:[/p][list][*][p]New zombie bosses[/p][/*][*][p]More heroes[/p][/*][*][p]More trinkets[/p][/*][*][p]At least four new zombie types[/p][/*][*][p]A score exchange shop (details TBD)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Our Commitment to All Captains[/b][/p][p]Thank you for reading this far, and most of all, for supporting us during the game’s launch. We have taken your suggestions and criticisms to heart. While promises can only go so far, we will do our utmost to repay your patience and support through ongoing updates.[/p][p]The upcoming v1.0.1 patch next week is just the starting point of our post-launch journey. We will keep listening to the community until the Last Ship becomes a fortress every Captain can rely on.[/p][p]We sincerely invite all Captains to follow our official social media accounts and join our player communities. This way, you can stay up-to-date on the latest news beyond Steam and participate in the community events we’re preparing.[/p][p]🌐 [b]Join the community below![/b]
💬 Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/vNGssanw"]https://discord.gg/vNGssanw[/url][/p][p]
🐦 Twitter: [url="https://twitter.com/ZombieRollerz"]@ZombieRollerz[/url][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]A Special Thanks[/b]
To [b]every Captain[/b] who left us reviews and comments: your expectations and support mean everything to us. We will work hard to optimize the game and make sure everyone can have a great time![/p][p]— With gratitude from the entire Zing Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Zombie Rollerz: The Dreadnought Community Contest!
notes.content: [h1][b]Welcome everyone![/b][/h1][p][/p][h3]The team at Zing Games and Wandering Wizard are ecstatic that there are so many out there who enjoy our game! With that, we wanted to take this opportunity to thank you all for playing thus far! ːsteamhappyː[/h3][p][/p][h3]To take the game further and see community sentiment and creativity, we have created this contest to see posts and social activity surrounding the game! [/h3][p][/p][h3]We have an awesome opportunity to partner with the influencer platform [b]NOIZ.gg [/b]that will be hosting our contest, if you want to enter, sign up on their platform now [url="https://noiz.gg/"]here[/url]![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576506/6fa0ca3a8f45bda15ad4a92fdbc7937a230c5093.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Here are the details surrounding this contest:[/h2][list][*][p][b]From June 27 - July 11, you the community are invited to post or create content regarding your favorite ship builds![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Who: [/b]Players and Influencers alike are invited to participate in a ship building contest to showcase their favorite ship builds. This build will showcase their favorite turrets, ship parts, favorite captain and favorite gadgets and starting trinkets that lead into gameplay of the ship build. [/p][/*][*][p][b]What + Where: [/b]Submissions will be in the form of, either a video on social media ([b]Youtube, X/Twitter, Instagram, Tiktok[/b], etc.) showcasing your ship building or a showcase video tied to a social text post with an explanation as to why the build is your favorite or best. You, the community are also [b]HIGHLY[/b] encouraged to post on the [b]Steam community Discussions[/b] [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2224120/discussions/"]here[/url] for extra visibility! [/p][/*][*][p][b]ALL SUBMISSIONS are required to have this hashtag on any social post: #ZombieRollerzContest[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Winning Criteria: [/b]While being viral/popular as a build is a factor in winning, the winner will be selected by [b]Wandering Wizard Games[/b] and [b]Zing Games[/b] for a post/video that is [b]thorough[/b] in explanation: A winning argument as to why your ship build is the best/most unique, that is persuasive enough to engage new and current and new players to try the build in-game. [b]Extra Brownie points for having a ship build for EACH DIFFERENT BIOME, as well as the build being UNIQUE rather than just overpowered, be creative! We want to see zombies taken out in your wildest creative ways![/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Now where will this be submitted for voting? Final submissions will be living on a [b]NOIZ Quest linked HERE[/b]: [url="https://noiz.gg/quests/Zombie-Rollerz-The-Dreadnought-Ship-Building-Contest"]https://noiz.gg/quests/Zombie-Rollerz-The-Dreadnought-Ship-Building-Contest[/url][/h3][p][/p][h2]Now here is what you are really here for, the Prizes![/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Grand Prize (1 winner):[/b] [b]512 GB, OLED Steamdeck Console![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576506/8007ddb3c6c80cf0b4859daf60e2bc50d9c0a7c5.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]2nd - 11th place:[/b] [b]$100 Steam Gift card code![/b][/h3][p][/p][h3]We look forward to your submissions! We are super excited to see your creativity as well as awesomeness from your builds![/h3][p][/p][p]More soon![/p]

notes.title: We won the NYX Game Award!
notes.content:
Captain! We got some exciting news to share!

Zombie Rollerz: The Last Ship just snagged the Gold Winner for Best Game Design in the PC Game category at the NYX Game Awards! Massive shoutout to our incredible community and the awesome team behind the game for making this incredible achievement a reality!

Thanks for rolling alongside us through this epic adventure. Our next destination will be attending the WePlay Expo this November as one of the "EXCELLENCE IN GAME DESIGN" finalists for 2023 indiePlay China Indie Game Award! We can not wait to showcase Zombie Rollerz: The Last Ship to players in the East!

But hey, the fun doesn't stop here! We've got more exciting updates coming your way! 

Be sure to keep tabs on our Twitter, Facebook, and join our Discord to stay connected and catch all the zombie rolling excitement.

Let's keep that momentum rolling and continue this wild ride together!
